newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy paper group Burgo firm on buy advice.
newsitem.headline: Italy paper group Burgo firm on buy advice.

text.p: Shares in Italian paper and packaging group Cartiere Burgo firmed after Milan brokers Pasfin and Milla said they recommended a "buy" due to a forecast recovery in the paper market in the second half of this year leading to better results.
At 1552 GMT, Burgo was 2.81 percent up at 8,370 lire after a session high at 8,450 on a weaker Milan bourse.
"The price of paper should rise from the start of the second half 1997," said Paola Toschi of Milla Sim.

Milla last month forecast Burgo 1996 net profit of 80.5 billion lire against 203 billion in 1995 with another weak year this year but with a significant upturn in 1998. "We have fixed a short-term target price of 8,650 lire," she said.
Pasfin saw 1996 net profit of around 89 billion lire and 113 billion in 1997.
"On a European level, producers are trying to implement a price rise of around eight percent," said Pasfin's Lucio Cannamela.
